description: Compress any conversation into a portable JSON context graph for handoff to a new chat or LLM. Trigger on: "compress this chat", "save context", "new chat", "hand off", "transfer context", "too many tokens", "start fresh", "export conversation", "context graph", "continue in new session". Also trigger proactively when the user mentions starting over in a long session.
